objective: Standard statement: (1) the cube minus an edge, unsigned, attached to an outside line and an outside point, has a constant count (a dead cap); (2) the k-snake, k copies of the exhibited soft crossing in series with capped plumbing (one host line on each wire between junctions), has a crossover-type Hadamard signature whose straight entries are fixed end factors times lambda_s^k, lambda = (360000, 3336, -10008, -192) up to scale; (3) the squares of the products prod_s lambda_s^{n_s} are distinct for distinct count vectors n with fixed total (prime valuations at 5, 139, 3); (4) interpolation: for a planar host with m snake sites, the counts at k = 1, 3, ..., 2N - 1 (N = C(m + 3, 3)) determine, by a Vandermonde system, the count with any crossover-type signature at every site, in particular an exact crossover; (5) demonstration: counts of signed K3,3 systems recovered exactly from counts of Pfaffian instances. Nearest known result: interpolation and crossover gadgets in Holant dichotomies (Valiant; Cai, Lu, Xia). Classification: to be decided.
status: Proved: counting on any cubic bipartite signed system reduces in polynomial time to counting on Pfaffian ones: dead caps (the cube minus an edge), k-snakes of the soft crossing (straight entries sigma_1 Lambda^(k-1), Lambda = (810000, 7506, -22518, -432), lattice condition at 5, 139, 3), long edges, two-parameter Vandermonde; K3,3 counts recovered from certified Pfaffian instances
title: A soft crossing interpolates to a sharp one
